test_title: PYST 19: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Hold someone or something at bay

options.text: Trap or corner a person or animal being hunted or chased
To seek punishment for a person or group
Prevent someone or something from moving closer
To thrive or to grow very successfully

solution:
The correct answer is **prevent someone or something from moving closer**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Hold someone or something at bay: ** in the position of being unable to move closer while attacking or trying to approach someone.

 
 
• **Example: ***The Indian soldiers keep the attackers at bay.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom is given in **option 3**.
